facts.statement: Laopteryx is a pterosaur found in the Upper Jurassic Morrison Formation of Wyoming, United States.
facts.quote: Laopteryx is the name assigned to a pterosaur (flying reptile) from the Upper Jurassic Morrison Formation of Wyoming, United States

facts.statement: The genus Laopteryx was named in 1881 by Othniel Charles Marsh.
facts.quote: The genus was named in 1881 by Othniel Charles Marsh

facts.statement: The holotype, a partial skull designated YPM 1800, was discovered in Quarry 9 at Como Bluff.
facts.quote: A partial skull, holotype YPM 1800, was discovered in Quarry 9 at Como Bluff

facts.statement: A single tooth found near the skull is referred to the type specimen.
facts.quote: There is also a single tooth, found near the skull and referred to the type

facts.statement: In 1986, John Ostrom restudied the fossil and concluded that Laopteryx was a pterosaur.
facts.quote: In 1986 however, the fossil was restudied by John Ostrom who concluded that Laopteryx was a pterosaur

facts.statement: Ostrom suggested that the single tooth likely belonged to a crocodylomorph.
facts.quote: Of the tooth he thought it likely belonged to some crocodylomorph

facts.statement: Laopteryx is regarded as a nomen dubium because its fragmentary remains are not diagnostic enough to classify future fossils.
facts.quote: The name is also regarded as a nomen dubium, because the fragmentary remains are not sufficiently diagnostic to refer future other fossils to it

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Laopteryx priscus, described by Marsh in 1881.
Another potential Archaeopteryx-type bird, Palaeopteryx, was described from the Upper Jurassic of the US about a century after Laopteryx.
facts.quote: Only a century later would another possible Archaeopteryx - type bird be described from North America: Palaeopteryx, also from the Upper Jurassic of the US

rejected.statement: Marsh originally identified the fossil as a bird about the size of a heron.
rejected.quote: Marsh identified it as a bird, about the size of a heron
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'a bird about the size of a heron'

rejected.statement: At the time of its discovery, it was considered one of the oldest known and the only one of that age found in America.
rejected.quote: As such it would have been one of the oldest known and the only one of that age then discovered in America
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'one of the oldest known and the only'
